# Navigate minecraft menus using your keyboard

This mod adds some useful shortcuts to minecraft menus to navigate without touching your mouse.

### Some examples:

| Title Screen     | Key |
|------------------|-----|
| SinglePlayer     | S   |
| Multiplayer      | M   |
| Minecraft Realms | R   |
| Options          | O   |
| Quit Game        | Q   |

| Game Menu              | Key |
|------------------------|-----|
| Back to Game           | B   |
| Advancements           | A   |
| Statistics             | S   |
| Options                | O   |
| Open to LAN            | L   |
| Save and Quit to Title | Q   |

See the video to see the shortcuts
